title: Celestial Spellcaster
description: A blue-skinned female sorceress with golden braided hair stands at an ornate blue lectern on a wooden stage, holding a glowing miniature galaxy in her raised hand. Behind her floats a large ethereal female face within a red orb, theatrical masks, scrolls, spell books labeled 'SPELL BOOK', an audience of silhouettes, and a dramatic night sky featuring a swirling black hole, red planet, comets, and stars.
prompt: A blue-skinned sorceress with elaborate golden braids stands on a wooden stage at an ornate blue lectern carved with faces, holding up a small glowing orb containing a galaxy. Behind her a giant luminous female face floats inside a red-pink orb, colorful theatrical masks and spell books are displayed, an audience watches from below, all set against a dramatic cosmic sky with a swirling black hole, red planet, and streaking comets in a rich fantasy illustration style.
